seed_items.canon_label_hint: storage-plan/FinalGUISpec projection trust states: current, refreshing, stale, degraded, unavailable + action-gating rules + fallback ladder
exact_items: current: projection is up to date enough for normal read + write
refreshing: slightly behind but actively catching up; read fine, write may still be fine
stale: data old enough that mutation-bearing actions should narrow or require refetch
degraded: projector or dependency failure means surface may be incomplete or partially wrong
unavailable: projection cannot support that surface; must fall back or disable

fallback ladder: widget summary -> native tab -> rollup tab -> filtered record list -> Ledger/History exact view
notes: Current docs establish canonical vs derived storage but lack UI policy; stale visibility != action authority
